description: Inve2st is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Universität Stuttgart - Zentrum für Interdisziplinäre Risiko- und Innovationsforschung (ZIRIUS). The aim of the model is to simulate the annual adoption of alternative drive systems of passenger cars by private persons. With the model results it is possible to compare these results with the targets that originate from energy system scenarios to fulfil the necessary CO2-emission reduction targets. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: investment-decisions. Software: Python. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
